ServerEngineIgnoreOutcome: At the actual receiver early return for a non-pending job/site, before its OK acknowledgement; capture code and exact job/site.
ServerEngineResolveMissingOutcome: At heartbeat-origin resolve_client_outcome under runner lock, using the actual missing-job observation, pending map and exception outcome.
ServerEngineReceiveAbortedOutcome: After accepted ABORTED report processing; capture actual exception classification with stronger-code precedence and cleanup requests.
JobExecutorClassifyAbortedExit: At get_return_code classification after physical exit, when the observed returned code is ABORTED and the executor's abort-request flag is set.
